tasks.title: The sneaky one
tasks.brief: This loop should add 2 to total each time round until total reaches 10, then print how many steps it took: Steps: 5.
tasks.starter:
total = 0
steps = 0
while total < 10:
    steps = steps + 1
print("Steps:", steps)
